name: shift-card

frames.best_why: Hover is complete: the portrait has shrunk to a corner avatar and the full bio, stats and Follow button are open.

tagline: Portrait card shrinks its photo and unfolds profile details on hover.
summary: A profile card that shows a large portrait at rest and, on hover, moves the photo into a small avatar while the name, bio, follower counts and Follow button slide up.
appearance: A tall dark rounded card. Its top strip pairs a green dot and Open to work with Design Engineer; a large rounded portrait sits centred above the name and an arrow. Hovered, the photo becomes a small corner avatar and dense text fills the lower half.
behaviour: Hovering shrinks the portrait into the top-left corner and expands a bottom panel to reveal bio, location, counts and a Follow button; leaving reverses it after a short delay.
demo_content: Sofia Marquez, Design Engineer, Lisbon, ex-Figma and ex-Linear, 4.2k followers, 318 following.
search_phrases: profile card that reveals details on hover
user card with photo and follower count
team member card with follow button
card that morphs portrait into avatar
hover card with bio and social stats
designer profile tile for a landing page
card that expands with contact details
people card with open to work badge
use_when: Introduce a person with a portrait and let their bio and stats appear without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Hover is required to read the bio, so touch and keyboard users only get the portrait and name.
customise: Four node props fill the top strip, portrait, hover avatar and bottom panel; card width, height and hover timing are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One portrait image and a few layout and height animations on hover.

a11y.note: Bio and stats open only on pointer hover; the card has no focus handling, so keyboard users cannot reach the details or Follow button.

issues: Bio, stats and Follow button are unreachable by keyboard; they exist only on hover.
On touch, a tap opens the panel and immediately closes it, so the details flash.
The card shows a pointer cursor and arrow but is not a link.
polish_why: The portrait-to-avatar morph is convincing; hover-only details and a dead arrow keep it from 5.
